{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
# Update checklist
p = 'specs/001-transactions/checklists/requirements.md'
s = open(p).read()
s = s.replace(
  '- [x] No [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers remain (0 found; resolved via
  Assumptions A1-A8)',
  '- [x] No [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers remain (0 found; resolved via
  Assumptions A1-A11)')
s = s.replace(
  '- [x] Requirements are testable and unambiguous (FR-001..FR-013 each state a
  concrete observable behavior)',
  '- [x] Requirements are testable and unambiguous (FR-001..FR-021 each state a
  concrete observable behavior)')
s = s.replace(
  '- [x] Success criteria are measurable (SC-001..SC-005)',
  '- [x] Success criteria are measurable (SC-001..SC-008)')
s = s.replace(
  '- [x] All acceptance scenarios are defined (14 Given/When/Then scenarios)',
  '- [x] All acceptance scenarios are defined (23 Given/When/Then scenarios
  across User Stories 1-4)')
s = s.replace(
  '- [x] Edge cases are identified (8 edge cases)',
  '- [x] Edge cases are identified (15 edge cases, incl. invalidate_many
  duplicates, resize no-op/empty, generator tags, expiry forward reference)')
s = s.replace(
  '- [x] User scenarios cover primary flows (P1 store/retrieve, P2 invalidate/LRU,
  P3 config/replacement safety)',
  '- [x] User scenarios cover primary flows (P1 store/retrieve, P2
  invalidate/LRU + multi-tag/resize/lazy tags, P3 config/replacement safety)')
s = s.replace(
  '''- Traceability: FR-001..FR-013 map to milestone requirements R01 (FR-002..004),
  R02 (FR-005..FR-009), R02 extension/Claim-A (FR-010), R03 (FR-001, FR-011,
  FR-012), and API preservation (FR-013).''',
  '''- Traceability: see the Requirement Traceability table in spec.md.
  FR-001..FR-013 cover milestone 1 (R01-R03, Claim-A extension, preservation);
  FR-014..FR-016 cover R04; FR-017..FR-019 cover R05 incl. the round-2
  absolute-expiry clarification; FR-020..FR-021 cover R06.
- Updated 2026-10-17 for milestone 2 (R04-R06) and Claim-A round-2
  clarification; the superseded design note is recorded as A9.''')
open(p, 'w').write(s)
print('checklist ok')

# Update HANDOFF.md
h = open('HANDOFF.md').read()
add = '''
## Milestone 2 + round-2 update (specify re-run, 2026-10-17)
- spec.md updated in place: User Story 4 added; FR-014..FR-021 added; SC-006..
  SC-008 added; edge cases extended; A7 revised; A9-A11 added; Requirement
  Traceability table appended.
- Active requirements now: R01, R02, R02 extension (Claim-A 2026-09-21), R03,
  R04, R05, R05 clarification (Claim-A round 2, 2026-09-22), R06, plus API
  preservation.
- Superseded: old design note 'empty all-tags matches every key and resizing
  may flush the cache' (A9) - MUST NOT be relied upon.
- Expiry: R07/R08 are referenced by the round-2 clarification but are NOT in
  the current milestone input; FR-019/A10 record the binding constraint for
  when they land; no expiry implemented in this milestone.
- Implementation status at this handoff: src/cachetools/tagged.py and
  tests/test_tagged.py NOT yet created (implementation phases pending);
  upstream suite baseline 216 passed (evidence
  aeccefc9fad8781fc6f8ef662aee28425a2f27191706206b35075cff99376eac).
'''
if 'Milestone 2 + round-2 update' not in h:
    open('HANDOFF.md', 'w').write(h.rstrip() + '\n' + add)
print('handoff ok')
PYEOF"}
